email.subject: URGENT: CPP-6612078 Endorsement Request for Summit Ridge Construction Inc.
email.body:
Hello,

Please process a mid-term endorsement for Summit Ridge Construction Inc. on policy CPP-6612078. We are requesting the change be effective 03/15/2026.

Please update the policy to reflect the requested endorsement change and advise if any additional information or signed forms are needed to bind the revision.

Thank you,
Derek Olsson
Summit Ridge Construction Inc.

Note: the policy number on the attachment may be off by a digit; the correct one ends in 9.
